name: point-blank
note: Two ships facing each other across an OPEN LANE at z=-230, behind the red ridges. The obvious setup - both on the centreline - buries them inside the Apex Spire, whose footprint is 164x148 around the origin, and then every shot fails line-of-sight for the wrong reason. Ship-forward is +z, so yaw +pi/2 faces +x. Exercises fire, lock, hit and kill.
